edition_title: Keen Africa Opportunities Digest: September 2026 Edition
edition_intro: This month brings a tight window worth moving fast on: Oxford and UK scholarships closing within days, a Nigeria-based leadership conference filling up in Enugu, and a national pitch competition open only to student founders already running a business. You already build things; these just give you the runway. Pick what fits your work and apply before the doors close.

posts.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/2028 (UK Master's)
posts.summary: Fully funds a one-year master's degree at any UK university, covering tuition, flights, and a monthly living stipend.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens with an undergraduate degree and at least 2,800 hours (roughly two years) of work experience

posts.title: Africa Prize for Engineering Innovation 2027
posts.summary: Awards up to £50,000 plus a year of tailored business support to African innovators building scalable engineering solutions.
posts.eligibility: Lead applicant must be a citizen of a Sub-Saharan African country, applying individually or as a small team

posts.title: Young African Leaders Conference (YALCON) 2026
posts.summary: A free, one-day leadership and entrepreneurship conference in Enugu bringing 300+ young Africans together to pitch ideas and access post-conference mentorship.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans committed to leadership, entrepreneurship, or sustainable development; entry is free but registration is required

posts.title: NANS Innovate 2026
posts.summary: A national pitch competition for Nigerian student entrepreneurs, with the top 20 winning transparent funding to grow their existing businesses.
posts.eligibility: Currently enrolled Nigerian tertiary students already running a business, from any of the 36 states or the FCT

posts.title: Cisco Networking Academy (Skills for All)
posts.summary: Free, self-paced courses in networking, cybersecurity, Python, and data science, with Cisco digital badges you can add to a CV immediately.
posts.eligibility: Open to anyone with a free Cisco Skills for All account; no prerequisites for foundation-level courses

posts.title: freeCodeCamp Certifications
posts.summary: Free, project-based certifications in web development, data analysis, machine learning, and more, each backed by a real portfolio of built projects.
posts.eligibility: Open to anyone with internet access; no prior coding experience or application required
